attackers_goals: Abuse exposed cryptographic keys to decrypt sensitive information or create digital signatures to craft malicious messages. Using the decrypted information, the attacker may perform additional activities in an evasive manner.
description: A cloud identity performed a key management operation for the first time.
investigative_actions: Check the identity's role designation in the organization. Verify that the identity did not perform any sensitive KMS operation that it shouldn't.
name: Unusual key management activity
